{{Top|leg}}
The '''Fest Alliance Forces''' were the [[Atrivis Sector Force]] combat forces assigned to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fest/Legends|Fest]]. They were mainly streetfighters, as the world was densely-populated. Due to tapped communication lines, many of the [[Fest commando unit]]s were assigned "hunting preserves" and left to conduct their own operations.
